summary: Implemented the JSON pretty-printing feature in the repository, but did not run the tests, per the instructions. Changes: rich/highlighter.py adds JSONHighlighter (combined regex, base style "json."); rich/json.py adds the JSON renderable (stdlib json parse/dumps, JSONHighlighter or NullHighlighter, no_wrap and overflow set on the Text, __rich__ returns it) and a __main__ entry with the file-read error path and soft_wrap printing; rich/console.py adds Console.print_json after print with a lazy import; rich/__init__.py adds package-level print_json after print (not added to __all__); rich/default_styles.py adds the six json.* keys; docs/source/console.rst gets a "Printing JSON" section, new docs/source/reference/json.rst, a reference.rst toctree entry; CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added line; tests/test_json.py is new. Expected ANSI strings in the tests were derived by reading Style._make_ansi_codes and are unverified until run. Known spec limitation: a string ending in an escaped backslash will not highlight as a whole. Nothing was committed.
